Express the vector $x=\overset{\to }{QR}$ in terms of the vectors $q$ and $r.$

                                        {{field-1}}                
                                    
                                
                                    
                                        
                                         $\text{ }$ (Type the vectors $q$ and $r$ as $q$ and $r$, respectively).
feedback.worked_solution:
According to the triangle law of addition, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{QR} & =\overset{\to }{OR}-\overset{\to }{OQ} \\ x & =r-q.\end{aligned}
$$
